schema: Execution log for each daily-brief run. One entry per run.

fields.started: ISO datetime when the run started
fields.completed: ISO datetime when the run completed
fields.deep_dive_category: Category slug for this run's deep dive
fields.new_cves_added: Count of new CVEs added to cves_seen.json
fields.new_items_added: Count of new items added to covered_items.json
fields.items_updated: Count of existing items updated in covered_items.json
fields.sources_consulted: Approximate count of distinct sources fetched
fields.notes: Run notes, errors encountered, or items deferred
